about: Candidate settings of the pooled LightGBM departure model, read by fleetreserve.learn_tune (plan section 7, pooled LightGBM; section 13, WP8). Every combination of num_leaves, min_data_in_leaf and one (learning_rate, rounds) pair is a candidate: 4 x 4 x 3 = 48. The settings of models.lgbm (15 leaves, 20 rows in a leaf, learning rate 0.05, 200 rounds) are one of them. Fixed before any run on training data; the SHA-256 of this file is written into the results and into the settings file made from them.
